key_reasoning.reason: Multi-repo changes with distinct content across 2 repos — scope scored additively. Backend: callback-page script no-opener branch and diagnostics model (opener_present tri-state). codemie-ui: two new abstractions (openSignInWindow opener-cutting helper, watchSignInWindow status-poll/early-close watcher), mcpAuthStatus client, useMCPAuthPrompt and useAuthCallbackListener (live-id acceptance window), chatGeneration store, useChatAuthCallbacks, AssistantAuthGateRow 'Open sign-in in a new tab' action. 4+ components across subsystems with new abstractions.

Core goal (survive the IdP opener guard) was clear, but design decisions surfaced during implementation: unplanned task 4b, a review fix-up round (6 findings), retry semantics for the closed-window status check, and a documented known limit (IdP error code cannot reach a window with no opener). Initial estimate was L (24); rework risk materialised.

Closest pattern is the existing postMessage callback listener, which assumes an opener; it does not cover the no-opener path, so polling, early-close detection and dual success reporting (poll plus postMessage) had no exact precedent. Touches the MCP OAuth sign-in flow (authentication), cross-window trust (opener cut, origin-checked postMessage), timers/races and the diagnostics beacon. Bumped from L for authentication.

27 files changed (3 backend, 24 codemie-ui), 1937 insertions and 251 deletions; 16+ maps to XXL. About 13 are test files and 1 is a guide doc, but diffstat mapping is applied as specified. Roughly 6 new files (openSignInWindow, watchSignInWindow, mcpAuthStatus and their tests).

UI (AssistantAuthGateRow), Service/state (hooks, chatGeneration store, utils), API (backend callback page and diagnostics endpoint model) and External (IdP opener guard, /v1/mcp-auth/status polling) across two separate codebases with a shared callback/diagnostics contract; no DB or infra. Raw sum was 26 (borderline); lean-higher rule applied because Technical Risk and Component Scope are XL, and the rubric text for multiple codebases supports XXL.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from L to XL: affects authentication (MCP OAuth sign-in) and cross-window opener/postMessage trust
Borderline 26 to 27: lean higher because Technical Risk and Component Scope are XL (Affected Layers set to XXL for multi-codebase scope)
Component Scope bumped: affects multiple workflows (chat auth gate, callback listener, store, backend callback page)
split_recommendation: Retrospective only (work is already implemented as two single-repo changes; initial estimate L 24 vs actual XL 27). Had it been split: by-component, backend codemie first (callback-page no-opener branch, opener_present tri-state diagnostics, INFO log level) then codemie-ui (openSignInWindow, watchSignInWindow and mcpAuthStatus helpers, then hook/store/AssistantAuthGateRow wiring).
